source.citation: Shahbazi, Menard, Sohn, Theau (2019), Unmanned aerial image dataset: Ready for 3D reconstruction. Data in Brief 25, 103962. DOI 10.1016/j.dib.2019.103962

processing.method: Parsed refined exterior orientation rows, joined timestamps and direct EOP comparison values, and transformed positions into Case Study B scene coordinates using the sampled TLS preview transform.

sceneTransform.note: Camera positions are centered and lifted with the same transform as the sampled TLS preview.

reviewStatus.notes: This layer shows the published camera positions and a flight-path preview. It does not reconstruct imagery or camera frustums yet; final CRS/orientation review remains required.
